turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, you're speaking with Daniel from Retailer One. Before we go any further I need to let you know that this call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. Do I have your consent to continue on a recorded line?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, that's fine, go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can I just confirm I'm speaking with the account holder, Sophie Tran, and that you're authorised to make changes to this account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's me. Sophie Tran, the account's in my name.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, thanks Sophie. And the supply address is 51 Main Road, Eltham, Victoria, three zero nine five?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's the one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. So this is about the Saver Flex plan. Before any numbers there's a short statement I'm required to read to you in full.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No worries.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Basically this plan works out a bit cheaper than the government's standard price, around four per cent or so, so you should be saving money.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, got it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A couple of quick questions first. Does anyone at the property rely on life support equipment, and do you hold a concession card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No to both.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me pull the pricing up for you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: On the Saver Flex plan your usage rate is 31.9 cents per kilowatt hour including GST, and the daily supply charge is ninety-eight point four five cents a day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That sounds reasonable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The rate isn't locked, we'd give you written notice before any change and you could leave then with no exit fee. Are you happy for me to go ahead?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, let's do it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's the best email for your welcome pack and contract? The cooling-off notice goes there too.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's sophie dot tran at gmail dot com.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lovely, got it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And just to confirm the NMI off your bill, I've got 6 1 0 2 1 2 3 4 5 6 7. Does that match?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that matches.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And this is electricity only, you're not bringing gas across?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Electricity only.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's everything. You'll get the welcome pack by email within one business day and your ten business day cooling-off period starts when it lands.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks Daniel, bye.
